text:
maya: Heads up — Snyk flagged a new OpenSSL CVE (CVE-2026-0007) hitting ubuntu:22.04-base and alpine:3.19 images we use for inference-runner. Looks like a high-severity crypto parsing issue.

sam: Do we have exploitability details? Is runtime affected or just the build-time tools?

maya: Advisory says use-after-free in ASN.1 parsing — remote exploit vectors exist for TLS parsers and some crypto tools. For our containers it's the libssl/libcrypto libs bundled in the runtime. Vendor patch available in openssl 3.1.2+ and backports for older openssl-1.1 packages.

tasha: TL;DR — we need image rebuilds. Questions: 1) can image-promoter re-sign artifacts after rebuild w/ our KMS? 2) do we need RBAC changes for the signer SA? 3) what audit logs/alerts to add?

jordan: Re: promoter/signing — image-promoter currently uses service account image-promoter@redwood.iam with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. For signing we need roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier or cryptoSign on the key. That SA doesn't have it today.

sec-oncall: Important: any RBAC grant must go through 2-person approval. Also we need audit logging on both the promoter job and KMS key usage. Specifically: image.promote events and kms.cryptoKey.sign operations.

maya: Proposed plan:
- Build patched images for ubuntu:22.04 and alpine:3.19 with OpenSSL 3.1.2/backport patch
- Run CI preflight (smoke + unit tests + minimal inference run)
- Canary promote to a small fleet with image tag redwood-patch/cve-2026-0007-canary
- Re-sign images using KMS after promotion
- Monitor error budgets and fallback to previous image automatically if regression.

sam: Sounds good. Additions: include musl vs glibc sanity checks (we saw odd syscall behavior previously), and run quick libcrypto FIPS self-test where applicable.

maya: Agreed. Also we should ensure the promoter SA is only granted cryptoSign on the specific key version. Limit scope.

infra-bot: Incident created: C-5412 - base-image-openssl-cve-triage (link: https://incident.redwood/C-5412)

tasha: I can own the RBAC change request and the IAM PR. Plan for the IAM PR: add roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier to image-promoter@..., conditioned to resource "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/image-sign" and add audit log sink to sec-logs. I will request approval from PO and sec-oncall.

sec-oncall: Add alert: metric-based on audit log entry count for kms.cryptoKeyVersions.use (or equivalent). Trigger when there are sign operations outside CI window or from unapproved SAs. Also add a dashboard panel for promoter job statuses and image verification failures.

jordan: Preflight test checklist (CI job):
- docker build with patched base
- run `python -m inference_serving --smoke`
- start container on amd64 and arm64 nodes (qemu where needed)
- run 50 rps load test for 5m (latency and mem)
- run end-to-end ML accuracy checks on 100 sample prompts

sam: What about deployment gating? Canary window and rollback policy?

maya: Canary window 6h with automatic rollback if error rate > 0.5% or 95th latency spike > 30%. On rollback, promoter should mark the bad tag and promote fallback tag. No customer-facing downtime expected.

tasha: Devops note — after rebuild we'll need to re-generate SBOMs and re-run the attestation signer job. Attestation relies on the KMS signature so I'll coordinate the re-sign step.

maya: Command snippet for manual re-sign (for runbook):
```
gcloud kms keys versions sign \\n  --location=global \\n  --keyring=images \\n  --key=image-sign \\n  --key-version=1 \\n  --digest-file=sha256.txt \\n  --signature-file=sig.bin
```

sec-oncall: Also capture in audit logs: who approved IAM PR, who triggered re-sign, and CI build IDs. We should ensure all these events are searchable and retained for 90 days.

jordan: I'll add the CI steps and the gating logic to the promoter pipeline. Will push a draft tonight for review.

maya: Can we schedule the canary for 02:00 UTC tonight? Need at least one oncall pair. @sec-oncall @tasha please ack.

sec-oncall: Ack. I'll be oncall.

tasha: Ack. I'll open the IAM PR and tag reviewers.

maya: Cool — I'll own triage notes and postmortem template if we need it. Let's keep communication in this thread. :thumbsup:
